lead: Cacao is the only chocolate product in this set with no sweetener of any kind, and the only one that pairs bone broth with added collagen. Its 23 g of protein beats every bone-broth and collagen rival. Where it falls behind is proof: most rivals point to third-party testing or a certification, and your pages don't mention testing at all.
note: As each brand states it on its own site or in a certifier's directory, checked Nov 12, 2026. "USDA Organic" means a certified product; "organic ingredients" means only some ingredients are organic. One-time prices; Bulletproof and Vital are their chocolate tubs.
panels:
Your quality edge

All 13 rivals sweeten their chocolate flavor with stevia, monk fruit, erythritol or sugar. Yours has none. You get bone broth and collagen in one scoop, 23 g of protein against 10 to 21 g from the bone-broth and collagen brands, plus organic cacao, MCT oil and sea moss. Per 10 g of protein you're level with Paleovalley ($1.54) and below the collagen-plus-MCT mixes from Bulletproof ($1.66) and Perfect Keto ($2.20).

Your quality gap

Ka'Chava, Vital Proteins and Ritual carry NSF or Informed Sport certification. KOS and Truvani publish batch results, and Ancient Nutrition and Equip say they test every lot. Since Consumer Reports' October 2025 lead tests, shoppers look for this. If you have test results, showing them backs up a premium price. Keep any zeolite wording clear of detox or binding claims.
